boundaries: Current roster and portfolio listing surfaces are dense and not hop-eligible.
A current portfolio listing is not a legal ownership, current-holding, control, board-right, or exact-vehicle record.
A fellowship title does not establish direct contact with its namesake, selector identity, or a relationship with every portfolio company.
School.House faculty, cohort, sponsor, panelist, and organizer labels are distinct predicates and do not establish pairwise coordination, investment, procurement, or government endorsement.
A Form D notice identifies filer-reported offering facts but does not map a vehicle to a portfolio-company transaction.
A firm or company announcement is not an independently verified technical, operational, acceptance, or performance record.
Current-page absence is not an exact departure event, and source failure is not evidence of absence.
No private material contributes to public coverage or assertion.
A state-registry route result, fictitious-name phrase match, owner name, FEI, or charter number is not a legal-identity join.
Publisher automation prohibitions and strict transport validation are custody boundaries and may not be bypassed.

An exact corporate owner record resolves the owner behind a fictitious-name candidate but does not establish that owner as the public School.House legal entity, fiscal sponsor, or governing organization.

An identifier-grade resolution of an IRS candidate, or the same EIN appearing on two Florida legal entities, does not establish either entity as BVVC's public School.House, a fiscal sponsor, an owner, a governing entity, or a common-control relationship.

A charity or report route, form-control map, bounded file sample, or data-subscription page is not a School.House legal-identity, exemption, filing, fiscal-sponsor, ownership, governance, funding, or control record.
North Carolina scripted interactive searches remain prohibited; only official reports, listings, subscriptions, and distinct downloadable surfaces may advance this lane.
An exhausted followed-route cap is a residual acquisition state and not denominator completion or evidence of absence.
A bounded file-sample hash binds only the acquired sample and not the complete remote report, dictionary, form, annual report, or archive.
Terminal custody for the frozen static residual route denominator does not resolve the School.House legal identity.
An HTTP 404 or 500 on an official route is transport custody and not evidence of record, filing, or entity absence.
A complete-file SHA-256 and fixed-term content screen establishes document custody, not School.House identity, filing, exemption, governance, funding, or control.
Zero fixed School.House or BVVC subject terms in the fifteen frozen North Carolina PDFs is not evidence that no legal entity, filing, exemption, sponsor, or governance record exists elsewhere.

A repeated first-party 501(c)(3), tax-exempt, nonprofit, or public-charity description is a self-description and not a registry-grade legal name, EIN, exemption, filing, fiscal-sponsor, governance, funding, or control record.
The repeated footer string © 2026 School House is a brand copyright string and not an admitted legal-entity name.

Zero exact legal-name candidates and zero organization JSON-LD rows in the complete query-free first-party surface denominator are bounded source observations, not evidence that no entity, filing, officer, board, sponsor, or differently named organization exists.

Archive CDX timestamps, original URLs, status codes, MIME types, digests, archived lengths, and replay locators are public locator metadata and not archived-content custody or registry-grade School.House identity evidence.

A bounded zero-row Archive response, or a provider error that persists after one exact serialized replay, is not evidence that no archived page, legal entity, filing, exemption, officer, board, sponsor, or differently named organization exists.
An Archive replay locator may not be dereferenced without a separately bounded acquisition that preserves publisher, privacy, identity, and absence-evidence controls.
A prelaunch parked-domain or third-party domain-marketplace surface is domain-history custody and not School.House legal-entity, governance, funding, ownership, or control evidence.

An archived first-party nonprofit or public-charity phrase is a historical self-description and not a registry-grade legal name, EIN, exemption record, fiscal-sponsor, formation, officer, board, governance, funding, or control record.

A provider error that persists after one exact bounded archived-content replay is transport custody and not evidence that no archived page, entity, filing, exemption, sponsor, officer, board, or differently named organization exists.

A Florida Check-A-Charity guidance capture establishes the scope of the state solicitation-registration service, not a School.House legal name, registration, exemption, EIN, sponsor, governance, funding, or control record.
An application-host timeout under urllib and IPv4/HTTP1.1 is transport custody and not evidence that no Florida charity registration or differently named legal entity exists.
Zero submitted registry queries is not a zero-result search; the fixed three-query matrix may be retried only after an observable provider-condition change.

A Form 990 filer selected from public institutional role continuity is an acquisition lead and not School.House legal-identity, fiscal-sponsor, related-party, funding, governance, or control evidence.
Zero fixed School.House, BVVC, fiscal-sponsor, or person-context term hits across two available Form 990 XML filings is a bounded searched-surface observation and not absence evidence.
Schedule I, L, R, or O presence is structural filing metadata and not evidence of a transaction, grant, sponsorship, related party, governance, funding, or control relationship.
An exact Form 990 XML member unavailable after one exact serialized replay remains source-unavailable custody and cannot support an absence claim.

A Florida corporate name containing SchoolHouse, an exact public-brand-base match, a city-level Tampa record, or a source-listed person-label match is candidate evidence only and does not establish the public School.House legal entity, governance, ownership, fiscal sponsor, funding, or control.

All twenty-two exact source-listed-person label matches are the common label Alex Martin and none overlaps a SchoolHouse-name corporation; common-name coincidence may not be promoted without independent identifier-grade alignment.

A complete July 2026 ten-partition Florida corporate bulk snapshot is bounded source custody, not evidence that no differently named, out-of-state, state-charity-only, historical, sponsored, or otherwise structured School.House legal entity exists.

A North Carolina static nonprofit report page, page title, county label, or unincorporated-nonprofit label is not a registry-grade School.House legal-identity, formation, officer, sponsor, funding, governance, or control record.

Zero rendered table rows across the two exact static report pages is page-structure custody, not a zero-result entity search or evidence that no North Carolina record, filing, sponsor, related party, or differently named corporation exists.

A static page anchor, location label, generic Business Registration link, or unrelated program listing is not a registry-grade School.House legal identity, formation, officer, sponsor, funding, governance, or control record.
Stable anchor cardinality across changed North Carolina page bytes and zero School.House or source-listed-person anchor signals do not establish record stability, identity, or entity absence.

The reconciled School.House legal-identity frontier contains twenty-three terminal public-source lanes bound to an authenticated 233-file canonical slice. Terminality applies only to those frozen inputs. It admits no public legal identity, relationship, negative-existence claim, publication, adoption, or graph effect; the lane may reopen only after a bound source digest, provider state, canonical blob, or registry-grade candidate materially changes.

interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This package separates current listings, source-specific role claims, firm self-representations, counterparty transaction announcements, and official filings. Dense rosters create no hops. Missing records and unresolved joins remain explicit coverage states.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A reproducible public-source inventory and acquisition frontier for the declared BVVC and School.House surfaces.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A finding of wrongdoing, coordination, motive, influence, government preference, technical performance, legal control, or completeness outside the declared surfaces.

purpose: A source-addressed, graph-inert public-record lake for BVVC, School.House, current and historical roster observations, legal vehicles, financing announcements, institutional self-claims, explicit rejected joins, IRS and state-registry legal-identity candidate custody, exact Florida fictitious-name and corporate resolution, Magnolia shared-EIN conflict custody, Florida-charity and North Carolina first-level, second-level, final static residual route, and complete-PDF hash and content-field custody, query-free first-party legal-surface, form-mechanics, and archive-locator metadata custody, related-charity Form 990 candidate screening, coverage nulls, and deterministic continuation work.

exclusion_rules: no private direct messages, screenshots, owner-supplied exports, contact details, or private-life facts
no selection based on criticism, ideology, nationality, military unit, fame, or anticipated scandal value
no conversion of marketing language into ownership, control, technical validation, government endorsement, or procurement influence
inclusion_rules: enumerate complete current leadership and portfolio page denominators before interpreting individual actors or companies
apply the same public-role and profile-resolution state to all current leadership labels
apply the same financing, legal-entity, governance-right, government-surface, and explicit-null battery to all current portfolio labels
preserve source-specific conflicts and sparse pages without reconciliation by inference
retain dense rosters as context-only and not hop-eligible
selection.selection_universe: Every visible name on the acquired current BVVC leadership page; every visible label on the acquired current Portfolio Universe page; every faculty, company, panelist, sponsor, organizer, and visible employee on the declared School.House surfaces; exact BVVC-branded SEC filers and filed related persons acquired in the bounded pass; and transaction-specific public announcements naming BVVC.
selection.symmetry_rule: An analogous defense-capital institution enters under the same complete-roster, exact-entity, transaction, governance-right, government-surface, temporal, and explicit-null rules regardless of affiliation.
